(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<80;i++){ if(window.__app) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); __app.showTab('library'); for(let i=0;i<40;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); if(document.querySelectorAll('.vgrid .tile').length>3) break; } return 'tiles in view: ' + document.querySelectorAll('.vgrid .tile').length; })()

(async()=>{ const i=document.querySelector('.lib-tools input[type=search]'); i.value='lens_eye fisheye_mono gopr0042'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); let names=[...document.querySelectorAll('.vgrid .tile .n')].map(n=>n.textContent); if(names.length < 3) { i.value=''; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); } return 'visible: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('.vgrid .tile .n')].map(n=>n.textContent).slice(0,8).join(', '); })()

(async()=>{ const want=['lens_eye.mp4','fisheye_mono.mp4','GOPR0042.mp4']; const g=document.querySelector('.vgrid'); let n=0; for (let pass=0; pass<30 && n<3; pass++) { for (const t of document.querySelectorAll('.vgrid .tile')) { if (want.some(w=>t.title.endsWith('\\'+w)) && !t.classList.contains('sel') && !t.classList.contains('selected')) { t.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); n++; } } g.scrollTop += 300; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); } return n + ' selected; bar: ' + document.querySelector('.sel-bar')?.textContent; })()

(async()=>{ document.querySelector('[data-tour=batch]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900)); const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); const b=[...m.querySelectorAll('.btn.primary')].pop(); const label=b.textContent; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const jobs=await vr180.queueList(); for (const j of jobs) await vr180.queueCancel(j.id); return label + ' -> queued: ' + jobs.map(j=>j.name + ' ' + j.status).join(', '); })()
(async()=>{ await vr180.queueClear(); const i=document.querySelector('.lib-tools input[type=search]'); i.value=''; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return 'ok'; })()
